gates.requirement: Explicit non-anthropocentric coding rules exist for innovation, traditions, cumulative improvement, repertoire breadth, distributed knowledge, externalization and open-endedness; pilot-driven changes must be logged.
Predictor families are frozen before confirmatory modeling; later additions require a logged rationale.
ACDB/source counts are available as first research-effort proxies, but module-specific search effort and tested-negative evidence must still be quantified.
Choose compatible phylogenies and define handling of taxa absent from trees.
Pilot matrix v0 exists for 25 taxa; 19 have an exact-species evidence route and six still require exact-species resolution or sensitivity-only treatment.
Toy simulation demonstrates meaningful model discrimination only with configuration-aware sampling and controlled missingness; repeat using observed pilot missingness before confirmatory analysis.
Define archaeological proxies, dating uncertainty and attribution rules separately from extant-species data.
Demonstrate that the contribution is not another list of human-uniqueness traits but an explicit cross-taxon test of causal configurations and bottlenecks.
Freeze exact ARIS release and commit before formal full run.
